```{r import_and_merge_datasets, include=FALSE}
library(haven)

current <- getwd()
while (basename(current) != "Data_center_and_fossil_energy_Replication") {
  current <- dirname(current)
}
base_path <- current

# Sub Path Setting
path_raw     <- file.path(base_path, "Data", "raw")
path_temp    <- file.path(base_path, "Data", "temp")
path_use     <- file.path(base_path, "Data", "use")
path_figures <- file.path(base_path, "Results", "Figures")
path_tables  <- file.path(base_path, "Results", "Tables")

# read data
data <- read_dta(file.path(path_use, "forR_placebo_cement.dta"))

```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Cox Regression: Cement, Steel, Iron Ore (25km only)
# ============================================================
library(haven)
library(survival)
library(dplyr)

distances <- c("25km") 
types <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24")
industries <- c("cement")

results_list <- list()

# ============================================================
# Run Cox Models for Each Industry
# ============================================================
for (industry in industries) {
  for (dist in distances) {
    
    proximity_vars <- paste0(industry, "_proximity_", dist, "_", types)
    proximity_formula <- paste(proximity_vars, collapse = " + ")
    
    formula_str <- paste0(
      "Surv(time0, time1, retire) ~ ",
      proximity_formula,
      " + Capacity_MW",
      " + Start_year",
      " + Heat_rate_Btu_per_kWh",
      " + Emission_factor_kg_of_CO2_per_TJ",
      " + rGDP_pc",
      " + elec_price_db_uscent_kwh_raw",
      " + td_loss_pct_output",
      " + demand_yoy_pct",
      " + renew_gen_share_pct",
      " + strata(Alpha_3_code)"
    )
    
    tryCatch({
      
      cox_model <- coxph(
        as.formula(formula_str), 
        data = data,
        cluster = GEM_unit_phase_ID,
        ties = "efron",
        control = coxph.control(iter.max = 200)
      )
      
      coef_summary <- summary(cox_model)$coefficients
      has_robust <- "robust se" %in% colnames(coef_summary)
      
      # Extract the sample used in the model
      used_rows <- as.numeric(rownames(model.frame(cox_model)))
      data_used <- data[used_rows, , drop = FALSE]
      
      n_obs <- nrow(data_used)                               
      n_events <- sum(data_used$retire, na.rm = TRUE)       
      n_units <- length(unique(data_used$GEM_unit_phase_ID))  
      
      # extract coefs
      for (i in 1:4) {
        type <- types[i]
        var_name <- proximity_vars[i]
        
        if (has_robust) {
          coef_val <- coef_summary[i, "coef"]
          se <- coef_summary[i, "robust se"]
          pval <- coef_summary[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        } else {
          coef_val <- coef_summary[i, "coef"]
          se <- coef_summary[i, "se(coef)"]
          pval <- coef_summary[i, "Pr(>|z|)"]
        }
        
        hr <- exp(coef_val)
        ci_lower <- exp(coef_val - 1.96 * se)
        ci_upper <- exp(coef_val + 1.96 * se)
        
        result_row <- data.frame(
          Industry = industry,
          Distance = dist,
          Type = type,
          Variable = var_name,
          Coefficient = coef_val,
          HR = hr,
          SE = se,
          CI_lower = ci_lower,
          CI_upper = ci_upper,
          P_value = pval,
          Sig = case_when(
            pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
            pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
            pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
            TRUE ~ ""
          ),
          N_obs = n_obs,           
          N_units = n_units,     
          N_retired = n_events     
        )
        
        results_list[[length(results_list) + 1]] <- result_row
      }
      
      cat(sprintf("✓ Successfully fitted %s model for %s (N=%d, Plants=%d, Retired=%d)\n", 
                  industry, dist, n_obs, n_units, n_events))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("✗ Error in %s %s: %s\n", industry, dist, e$message))
    })
  }
}

# ============================================================
# Process Results
# ============================================================
if (length(results_list) == 0) {
  stop("No models successfully fitted!")
}

results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)

period_order <- c("before06", "06_15", "16_19", "20_24")

results_df <- results_df %>%
  mutate(Type = factor(Type, levels = period_order)) %>%
  arrange(Industry, Type)

saveRDS(results_df, file.path(path_temp, "cox_proximity_results_industries_25km.rds"))
write.csv(results_df, file.path(path_tables, "sup_table05_cement_placebo_source.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n=== Analysis Completed ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Total coefficients: %d\n", nrow(results_df)))
cat(sprintf("Significant results (p < 0.05): %d\n", sum(results_df$P_value < 0.05)))
cat(sprintf("Sample: N_obs=%d, N_units=%d, N_retired=%d\n", 
            unique(results_df$N_obs), unique(results_df$N_units), unique(results_df$N_retired)))

cat("\n=== All Coefficients ===\n")
print(results_df %>% 
  select(Industry, Type, HR, CI_lower, CI_upper, P_value, Sig, N_obs, N_units, N_retired))

```
